issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a CI lane that actually tests the declared MSRV instead of asserting it: a `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` step in the bead-rs-ci Argo WorkflowTemplate, with the lane toolchain pinned to the exact version declared in Cargo.toml's rust-version and CI failing on drift between the two. README and AGENTS.md claim 'Rust 1.85 is the MSRV' but nothing exercises 1.75/1.85 in any lane, so the claim is honest only by luck and any dependency refresh can silently break the floor. Land the lane, prove it passes against the current lockfile, and add a guard that fails when the manifest version and the lane toolchain diverge.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned Rust 1.85 MSRV verification lane to bead-rs CI (ADR-004)

issue.description:
ADR-004 (Accepted) requires a pinned MSRV lane in `bead-rs-ci` — `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` — so the declared Rust 1.85 floor is tested on every run instead of asserted, and explicitly requires that 'the lane must pin the same version the manifest declares; drift between them is a CI failure, not a doc nit'. No open bead covers the lane or its drift enforcement (the open CI beads cover release artifacts and the install contract only). Scope: add the lane pinned to exactly the manifest's `rust-version`; add a parity check that fails CI when the pinned toolchain and `rust-version` diverge, so the floor cannot silently rot; rerun the lane after dependency refreshes — the 2026-08-22 refresh is precisely the 'dependency update silently breaks the untested floor' scenario the lane exists to catch.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned MSRV verification lane to bead-rs-ci with manifest toolchain-parity enforcement (ADR-004)
